title: Tangential Surface Pressures and Boundary Localization in Disordered Edwards--Anderson Models
summary: We study boundary free energies in disordered Edwards--Anderson Ising models. For rectangular strips of fixed width, we prove that the expected free-to-fixed boundary correction, divided by the tangential length, converges for every finite inverse temperature and at zero temperature. The proof combines a uniform almost-additivity estimate with product-measure concentration, yielding self-averaging along tangential intervals.
